## Activity

During June 2024, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 445 captures. This is the total activity reported for the month. The activity measure covers the captures completed at the site and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

Of the 445 captures, 26 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.8 per cent. These figures should be considered together when reviewing the quality of images available for grading. The reported rate provides the proportion of captures that could not be graded, while the count records the number of ungradable captures during June 2024.

## Grading

The site recorded 120 referable results. The median grading lag was 4. This records the central grading turnaround measure for the month. Taken together, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide the reported operational position for West Gate Eye Clinic in June 2024.
